findings.text: The committed line figure is stale and contradicts the aligned record: it draws the enabled arm's post-drop point at 0.0 with the label 'after dropping 10 handles' (the withdrawn a9c29fa7 post-hoc reading), while the active receipt (receipt.json:7, :2590) copies job 1280456's alive_executable_graphs_after_drop 2 and release_established false, and the current measure_cuda_graph_count.py:310-317 plots summary.alive_executable_graphs_after_drop (2) under the label 'settled reread after dropping N handles'. The report records that the fresh settled reread produced no count and that release is unmeasured, but it never states which of the two the count is -- the answer the done-when does name ('the report ... states which of the two it is, with the evidence that decides it'). With the ladder's flat count and release unmeasured, the posed alternative (per-executable-and-released, vs process-cumulative) is left open, so the node's terminal artifact carries no answer to its own goal.

The command-buffers-disabled control arm recorded zero count observations (receipt.json:2346 onwards; count_events empty), so the reported disabled_control_maximum 0 is the absence of any lifecycle count, not a measured control reading. With XLA_FLAGS=--xla_gpu_enable_command_buffer= no executable graphs are created at all, so the arm cannot demonstrate that the instrument registers graphs (no positive control); the enabled arm's maximum 2 against the motivating failure's 1669 also reads as a regime mismatch the report does not address.

follow_ons: The node's own follow-on stands: build an on-demand XLA alive-graph count query that fires after device synchronisation without graph dispatch, then run a fresh completed two-arm titan measurement; no production repair is chosen beforehand. Additions from this review: regenerate or drop the stale figure so it agrees with the aligned receipt; use a control arm that can register a non-zero reading (a positive control) rather than a command-buffer-disabled arm whose count is necessarily absent; and close the regime gap between the flat ladder (max 1-2) and the motivating failure's 1669 alive graphs before any verdict is drawn from the instrument.
